Midwife Yolande Maritz_Follow up

By: Tarryn Crossman | Delivery

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

Unique Selling Point:
Yolande Maritz update

Since we broadcast so many more woman have come forward. A baby died on the 26th December 2020 after YM failed to react to a scan that showed baby was in distress. She also allowed the mom to go to 42 weeks and 3 days instead of referring her at 41 weeks.

5 of them have submitted official claims against YM at SANC.
SANC have come back to me saying that they had complaint against Yolande that was under investigation before we did the story and now they have 5 more. At the time they said they had one and she was found not guilty

They had a meeting to decide if they will proceed with an investigation against YM on the 24/25 of February.

At this stage she is registered as a midwife to practice in 2021



Further information:
New case studies

Chichi - Birthed with YM in 2020 after our show went out
Facts:
- She saw the show at 39 weeks and after contemplating moving she decided to stay with YM as it was so close to her due date
- No backup Gynie
- 41 weeks – she has messages between her and YM. She is saying she is scared because it is 41 weeks already and YM is saying don’t stress.
- YM says baby will come when its ready. You can wait
- Legally you have to be referred to a Doctor if the baby hasn’t come by 41 weeks
- 42 weeks – she went to Yolande and she did a
1. A Stress test
2. internal
3. A stretch and sweep
- That day Yellow discharge when she got home – YM says not to worry its normal
- Dark discharge in the morning and they said its nothing come in on Friday
- Suddenly YM called and said please come in by 12 that same day
- She arrived and then when they checked YM said sorry there is no heart beat
- They asked to be taken to the hospital, she said no you will have to go in your own transport Ambulance won’t take you
- Went to Linksfield and they said that her BP was too high
- Dr looked at the tests done at YM and said that the baby was clearly in distress and should have been delivered immediately
- Dr advised that she goes to the police and report her immediately
- Working on getting DR to speak

Chrisiaan 2019
Facts:
- Was with YM her whole pregnancy
- YM did all the scans
- Same story – even though mom was not feeling well and had bleeding, YM insisted she was fine
- Baby died at steven biko after an emergency C-section
- Diagnosis: Gastrochrisis
- Diagnosable from 14 weeks via a sonar
- Basically the babies bowels are the outside of its body.
- This condition has a 90% survival rate
- Baby died because it was not diagnosed and therefore the correct protocols weren’t in place to ensure a safe delivery
- Files from Steve Biko

Tanita – Birthed with YM in Bloem in April 2017
Facts:
- She was with YM her whole pregnancy
- YM did all the scans
- Went to a GP at 34 weeks, at YM suggestion as she couldn’t see her. GP said there is a problem as baby is still 29 weeks gestational age and there is very low abiotic fluid
- YM said don’t stress you will be fine, drink pear juice to get more fluid
- Some babies are small etc ..
- Tanita Didn’t feel right after that
- YM kept saying you are find your BP is a bit high but don’t stress
- She started bleeding and after begging YM for help she decided to take herself to ER
- On Arrival placenta had ruptured and baby had a lack of oxygen
- Dr who received her at the ER blames YM’s negligence and says that if Tanita had waited any longer her and the baby would have die. Will only speak anonymously

Script:


Yolande Maritz is an advanced midwife who offers Natural, mostly water birth, deliveries at her home birthing centre You and Me. She started in Bloemfontein and then moved her practice to Pretoria. In October last year we investigated various allegations of misconduct by Maritz that may have result in two babies dying and two being born with Cerebral palsy

Alysia raw interview: 00:23:43:21 - 00:24:16:23
She doctor devet opened up a back office for us and they took him off everything and they gave him to us and he was alive for five hours and then he passed away.

CHANEL: We are looking at a case of negligence.
Husband: We basically just trying to get her license taken away so she can practice anymore.

ELSA’S RAW INTERVIEW
00:42:26:15 - 00:42:49:26
Yolanda tried to resuscitate our daughter with a state of state discussed that she asked from one of the. Teams standing there that she wants to borrow the state to scrub and Kathy used a hand pump a ventilator on my daughter and that's how they tried to resuscitate my daughter on literally on my chest
00:43:12:22 - 00:43:16:00
and they declared my daughter at 17 44.



At the time Maritz denied all the claims against her

Derek: Do you think that you are at all responsible for what has happened to any of these babies. Ym: No.
D: The deaths and brain injuries.
Ym: No none at all.
Ym: They want to project their guilt on someone else


After that story aired more and more women starting coming forward with allegations against Maritz
One was Tanita Brown. In 2017 Tanita fell pregnant with her first baby and she chose Maritz as her primary caregiver.

00:01:48:11 - 00:02:25:04
the first time we went to see L.A. was on the 12th of May 2017. Everything was fine. She told us that we can consider to get a back up gynae and I need to go see him any time in the next month

But Dr Le Roux, not his real name, the Gynaecologist that Tanita wanted to use refused to work with Maritz.


DOCTOR:
00:01:07:11 - 00:01:11:16
Because we didn't have a trust relationship
00:01:12:24 - 00:01:21:22
And her reputation proceeded with bad incidents to we had at the hospital with a patient of hers, so.

Ironically when Tanita and her baby were rushed to Emergency Dr le roux was the Gynaecologist on call that night

00:14:48:19 - 00:14:59:14
when I first saw Tanita, I was I was angry. How could this happen out without notice out of the blue?

At 30 weeks Tanita went to Maritz for an ultrasound, it was around this time that things started to go wrong

00:07:57:18 - 00:08:21:05
She told me that everything is OK with baby, but it is a bit smaller than he should be. But she said to me, I have nothing to worry about. It's easier to birth a small baby than a bigger one and everything will be OK

Doctor
00:08:06:26 - 00:08:24:02
what should happen in an ideal world is if a midwife finds the baby small for gestational age, that mother needs to be referred to a specialist to see what is going on.
00:08:25:22 - 00:08:39:29
Yeah, and a midwife is not trained to make diagnosis and to handle into, uh, intrauterine growth restriction. That is that is why they are specialists.

At this point Tanita says she also explained to Maritz that her feet and legs had begun to swell and become painful, which are medical symptoms of Pre-clampsia or high blood pressure

00:07:06:11 - 00:07:37:00
she said to me it could be the high blood pressure, but I shouldn't worry. I should just drink the magnesium and I should get my legs up.


4 weeks later at 34 weeks Tanita went to see the GP that Maritz worked with who also flagged that her blood pressure was too high and that Baby was not growing, as he was a month too small

00:12:46:00 - 00:12:59:22
the general practitioner obviously called Yolanda Mouritz and explained everything to her, to which you advised me to get Pager's to increase my amniotic fluid, also to get bedrest and to drink some Lekman to boost my nutrients.

That same day Tanita started to feel worse and worse, she was constantly texting Maritz asking her what to do
00:13:47:06 - 00:14:19:23
she told me at about five o'clock to check my blood pressure, which I did. And it was one hundred and sixty three over one hundred and eight. She then told me, OK, I need to take my blood pressure pills again, wait 30 minutes and check the blood pressure again.
00:14:24:03 - 00:14:26:19
And then after you showed it was high again, she said.
00:14:28:03 - 00:14:38:28
After that, she told me. Then I just need to take my pills, make sure that I'm taking the pills right, and I just need to wait for them to start kicking in when.


DR:
00:10:41:20 - 00:10:55:28
I saw a patient with a blood pressure with a diastolic of 108 in the valuable time of the pregnancy. I would always admit them and start picking them up for preeclampsia
00:10:56:00 - 00:11:02:15
And if it is preeclampsia, we know they're going to deliver earlier.
00:11:03:06 - 00:11:12:18
We know this and we know if we don't do something, it often ends up in an intrauterine death or a your placenta, which is exactly up in the.

At 7pm that evening according to Tanita she couldn’t handle the pain anymore, Maritz finally told her to go to the ER
00:15:33:18 - 00:16:11:27
I started bleeding excessively. It was absolutely horrifying. We were so scared. It was so much blood and got in the car and we drove so fast to the hospital

According to DR Le Roux, Tanita went into preterm labour because maritz had not diagnosed her preclampsia

00:07:20:04 - 00:07:21:09
She had pre-eclampsia
00:07:23:02 - 00:07:27:10
and she had intrauterine growth restriction severely.
00:07:28:27 - 00:07:33:00
And that is how it usually ends if you don't intervene earlier.

Tanita:
00:17:37:26 - 00:18:06:19
It was a matter of ten minutes and baby was out. He was blue. It was it was the scariest time of my entire life that I thought my baby was going to die.

00:06:55:15 - 00:07:04:25
She had fractured the center, which we call it a ruptured placenta. That means the placenta is starting to come loose from the side of the wall of the uterus.
00:11:21:10 - 00:11:31:20
the placenta already came loose and the baby couldn't get oxygen from the mother.
00:11:33:17 - 00:11:35:23
So that's why the baby had asphyxia.
00:11:36:03 - 00:11:49:18
So if that had continued for longer, the baby would have died and if that baby had been born in a place where there wasn't immediate resuscitation or immediate in a neonatal ICU with that baby has five.
00:11:54:16 - 00:12:00:24
Without the neonatal ICU in a baby that size with. Asphyxia.
00:12:02:14 - 00:12:04:10
The baby would struggle to survive.

tANITA
00:19:07:26 - 00:19:18:18
The doctor told us the gynecologist at the hospital told us that if I had arrived five minutes later, I would have bled to death and my baby would have died from lack of oxygen.


Chichi was 39 weeks pregnant when she watched our investigation into Yolanda Maritz in October 2020

00:01:25:11 - 00:01:40:03
Yes, I saw the cutline show on Yolanda, but I was already 39 weeks. So we tried changing hospital midwives and everything. But the pressure, I also felt like it was just way too late.

00:0725:06 - 00:07:53:07
Episode I sat down with my family, my husband, trying to decide other means, but I guess it was way too late also because I didn't want to use a state hospital. So because we had also paid already. So it was just complicated. And that's when. I decided to just give a benefit of the doubt and yes.

00:07:54:05 - 00:07:56:25
Do you agree with that? I regret that.

00:32:56:00 - 00:33:03:27
If I had made a decision to not use her because she had been exposed, maybe my child would have been alive,

This was CHICHI’s first baby, she didn’t know what to expect or how things were supposed to work. She put all her trust in Yolanda Maritz as her midwife and primary caregiver

00:05:12:12 - 00:05:16:09
I saw her, I think twice a month. Twice every month.
00:05:21:17 - 00:05:23:15
I would get there and
00:05:25:09 - 00:05:34:05
she would test my my blood pressure. Um, do a ozona. Yes, that's just basically what she was doing all the time.
00:05:36:02 - 00:06:10:02
And surprisingly, she would say the baby is fine all the time. Even the times when I would go there and I have swollen hands and swollen feet and I can feel that I'm depressed, my blood pressure is high. She would always say everything is normal, the baby is fine. You're fine

Video of chichi dancing

As the weeks went on though and Chichi started to head into her 40th week of pregnancy she started to feel like something was wrong

00:06:32:14 - 00:07:07:27
So I started having this numbness on my hands. I couldn't feel my hands. I couldn't touch. So people were just saying it's a sign of high blood pressure. And my my feet was well, and I couldn't do anything. I I'd spent the whole day lifting them up and I would call her and tell her that I don't feel fine, I'm not OK. And she would actually have a text message as we should told me. No. Did you focus your losing focus now? And I'm like, no, but I, I feel different and I'm not OK.
00:07:08:19 - 00:07:14:24
Then she would just tell me that I should focus. So I remember I remained calm.

40 weeks became 41, which became 42 weeks. Chichi and her husband had done the babies room, she was bouncing on her birthing ball and eating all the food to bring on labour but the baby wasn’t coming

00:10:45:00 - 00:10:54:09
Well, I was forty two weeks. I went to her and like I said, I kept on telling her that I'm scared. Now what is going on?
00:10:56:17 - 00:11:13:15
And then she said everything is going to be OK. So what I'm going to do is I will bring you in naturally induced you and then you get into active labor.

Yolande then did a stretch and sweep, which is a fairly gentle natural way of inducing labour.
She also did an NTSC test on the baby
00:16:41:23 - 00:16:43:29
She didn't need to scan.
00:16:44:17 - 00:16:46:15
I could feel my baby's heartbeat.
00:16:51:02 - 00:16:53:15
She didn't say that the baby was in distress.
00:16:53:17 - 00:16:57:25
She didn't say the baby was tired or anything

We obtained this copy of the NTSC done on Chich during this visit and according to the gynaecologist we consulted it was already obvious at this point that Chichi’s baby was in distress and she should have been referred to a hospital

DOCTOR
00:17:45:14 - 00:18:06:09
I wouldn't let a pregnancy go further than 41 weeks. As a rule, because your rate of stillbirths. Uh, starts getting Feili after forty one weeks
00:18:09:19 - 00:18:21:02
the official guidelines is 42 weeks
00:19:22:28 - 00:19:31:27
Placenta is not designed to work longer than forty two weeks. It will stop working.
00:19:32:21 - 00:19:43:10
Which means then the baby doesn't get its its nutrients
00:18:22:14 - 00:18:41:15
You only need to have experienced one or two stillbirths at 42 weeks and then you will never go to forty two weeks again.

00:18:06:11 - 00:18:13:26
The following morning, I call Yolanda Lundi, I keep discharging this yellow fluid that I don't understand,

00:18:15:14 - 00:18:25:29
and she said, OK, you can come back tomorrow as in the other day, so that I can just activate jalebi and give birth.
00:18:29:29 - 00:18:54:14
After that. I think my husband going to work and I was just walking around the complex, my usual routine, then that's when I get a call from your lady, you can come in now.
00:18:58:16 - 00:19:06:15
The first thing we did was to set up the birthing room and then I sleep so that they can do that, Anestis can bring in.

00:19:07:26 - 00:19:10:15
That's when she said, I'm sorry, I can't feel your baby's IPID.

00:19:12:03 - 00:19:23:02
Her exact words were, and they echo in my mind every day, she said, oh, gee, I don't know why God is doing this to you. I can't feel your baby's heartbeat.
00:19:43:11 - 00:19:58:06
She only said that so it was me and my cousin and my husband. So when she said that, I thought maybe it's a process whereby when it happens, you go to the hospital, they resuscitate the baby or something.
00:21:25:23 - 00:21:27:24
That's when I asked, what are we going to do?

00:21:29:25 - 00:21:33:23
And then she said, you have to go to a state hospital.
00:21:40:20 - 00:21:56:20
You have to go there because they have to confirm if my next test is correct, if your baby is really dead or not. So even myself, when I went to the hospital, I had a hope that she made a mistake somehow.

At 42 weeks and 3 days Chichi’s baby was still born and she never heard from Yolanda Maritz again


00:25:46:18 - 00:25:51:11
She lied to me
00:25:53:10 - 00:26:00:09
I was contacting through WhatsApp
I was asking her
00:26:02:26 - 00:26:29:27
can you please give us back the money we gave you so
so that I can give my child a dignified set of.
00:26:31:18 - 00:26:34:12
She refused and she blocked me for asking.


Chrisiaan was 25 years old and pregnant with her second baby when she went to see Maritz

00:02:02:07 - 00:02:10:05
The first meeting we went in, she was she was nice. She took me to the room for the seminar.
00:02:10:14 - 00:02:34:25
She did a seminar. Everything was fine. She told me my daughter, she was actually a son.
00:03:27:05 - 00:03:37:03
She told me I'm a CFO every four weeks and I asked them I still go to the state hospital as I was still at state to do my seminars and everything.
00:03:37:05 - 00:03:55:22
And she said, no, she'll be Dicenzo's every four weeks. There is no need to go to the state hospital anymore.

00:04:36:00 - 00:04:46:25
All right, so then what ultrasounds did you learn to do so from that one you went every four weeks with ultrasound, the first one she did, the normal ultrasound did.
00:04:47:04 - 00:04:53:12
And she told me everything was fine. There's no need to stress the baby's healthy, the baby's picking up weight.
00:04:59:28 - 00:05:04:13
The second ultrasound was about twenty four, I think. Twenty four weeks.
00:05:04:21 - 00:05:11:13
And they she also said there's no need to go to the gynae. Everything is fine. The baby is healthy.

according Chrisiaan at around 29 weeks she started to feel like something was wrong, she was in pain and had started to get a strange discharge

00:08:40:09 - 00:09:00:12
she told me, just relax, there's nothing wrong. It's just your imagination. And I went to hospital anyway.
00:07:04:19 - 00:07:32:03
I got into hospital and I was already being dilated and the baby was in distress and I didn't have infection. It was actually my mucus plug coming out So they had to stop the labor at the hospital.
00:07:33:11 - 00:07:36:03
Were you panicking when you were at the hospital?
00:07:36:18 - 00:07:39:06
Course, I was twenty nine weeks pregnant.
00:07:40:13 - 00:07:49:29
And she kept on saying, it's just it's my tummy, Strix is stretching, stretching, but at the hospital, what were they saying?
00:07:50:01 - 00:07:52:26
Were they saying that it's contractions, it's
00:07:54:17 - 00:08:10:21
dilating, the baby's in position to come to come out and they say they gave me shocks to strengthen the lungs. They gave me pills to stop the labor as it was still too early to birth the baby.
then I had a follow up meeting with the doctor as well.
00:08:40:09 - 00:09:00:12
And with this so they told me that my baby has gastroschisis.

Gastroschises is a birth defect in the Abdominal wall, where the babies bowls are outside of its abdomen

Chrisiaan
00:10:00:11 - 00:10:12:21
they told me that you can actually see it from 12 weeks, you can see it on a sign from 12 weeks.
00:10:15:08 - 00:10:27:12
So are you saying that the scans at your lender had been doing she could have picked it up, but didn't the doctors at hospital picked it up so she could have as well?


DOCTOR:
00:23:59:29 - 00:24:08:02
Ultrasound examination, ultrasound examination is a thing you need to be trained to do.
00:24:10:03 - 00:24:13:29
And there's certain levels of training, so you get a level one, level two, level three.
00:24:18:15 - 00:24:25:17
And ultrasound in some that's not correctly trained is dangerous
00:24:27:02 - 00:24:46:22
Um. The the the incidence of abnormalities with babies is five percent maybe of all pregnancies. So if you sit with a Fisher-Price sonar machine and you tell every patient they are fine, you will have a 95 percent chance of being correct.
00:24:48:13 - 00:25:00:12
So what is where the training comes in is to pick up that five percent.

CHRISTIAAN 00:14:21:24 - 00:14:29:02
she actually placed a scan on the Gastroschisis and told me it's in Benegal called.

Gastroschises can be diagnosed from around 12 weeks of pregnancy and in developed countries the survival rate is 90-95% largely due to early diagnoses and then a carefully planned delivery. But due to low antenatal diagnosis in South Africa the survival rate drops to 47%

Because the delivery was an emergency the medical team needed to operate on Chrisiaans daughters Gatrochrises where not present and during the wait a section of her Bowl died, post op she got septicaemia and eventually passed away

00:25:35:19 - 00:26:10:25
the doctor came to see us and she told us, I'm sorry to tell you this, but your daughter's organs are failing. Her bones are failing. Her brain is failing. Everything is failing. So unfortunately, we still have a few minutes left with that. We went back into my daughter's room and about two minutes after she took her last breath, we spend a few minutes of hours with them.
00:26:11:03 - 00:26:17:06
And so I couldn't take it anymore. Was it wasn't right for her laying there with the lifeless body.

Link: After our show broadcast at the end if 2020 many of the women we spoke to and more submitted official complaints against Maritz to the South African nursing council who are ultimately responsible for the registration of private midwives in South Africa

TANITA: 00:22:29:18 - 00:22:54:04
I would really like her license to be taken away so that she can just stop putting babies lives and mommy's lives and all lives in jeopardy

VO: These cases are still being investigated along with a case from 2016, SANC was unable to give us a date that all investigations into Yolanda Maritz would be concluded.


LINK: Regardless of the magnitude of these complaints Maritz has been registered by SANC for 2021

VO: We requested an interview with sanc but they declined stating that
they are busy following the legislative processes of the Nursing Act and will not be party to trying Ms Maritz in the media.

CHICHI 00:34:08:24 - 00:34:12:27
I don't wish anybody to go through what I went through
00:34:58:15 - 00:35:01:29
I wanted to be stopped. I want your lender to be stopped.
